summary: Comprehensive iter2 backend + frontend smoke testing. Backend: 23/23 pytest passing covering reseed, makes (30 with cascading models), customer minimal-save regression, inline vehicles, quotation expiry, convert→job, timer auto-status progression, payments (cash partial, knet/credit_card auth_code enforcement, balance paid via knet, admin-only delete), invoice edit recompute, completion auto-INV number, notifications shape, sales/pnl/jobs/customer-history reports, role enforcement. Frontend smoke: login OK, customer min-save OK, inline-vehicle row OK, 5 WhatsApp icons rendered, Settings 'New Make' button present, Reports page shows date filters + 7D/30D/90D presets + Apply + P&L card (Revenue/Discounts/Tax/COGS/Gross Profit) + payment-method donut + Sales-by-service chart + CSV downloads, Cmd-K palette opens on Ctrl+K, header has Search ⌘K + bell with badge=3 (visible in screenshot).

issues: Test heuristic searched body text for 'Outstanding' on dashboard and did not find it; main agent should visually confirm the 5th metric card 'Outstanding A/R' is present and labeled correctly. Reports page shows outstanding context, but dashboard label needs eyes-on verification.

Radix console accessibility warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for some dialogs (e.g., CommandPalette). Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add DialogDescription to silence.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings while the command palette overlay is open (container momentarily 0-sized). Minor; suppress with minWidth/minHeight or aspect.

action_items: Verify Dashboard explicitly renders the 5th 'Outstanding A/R' metric card (text not detected via DOM body scan during smoke).
Optional polish: add DialogTitle/Description (or VisuallyHidden) to CommandPalette and any modals lacking it to clear Radix a11y warnings.
Optional polish: give chart containers minHeight to avoid recharts width(-1) warning when overlays open.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1155 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, customers.py, jobs.py (payments+timer), quotations.py, reports.py, seed.py.
Computed numeric tolerances rely on round3 with 1e-9 nudge; payment_status threshold uses 0.001 — fine for KWD 3-dp, just document.
_is_expired() relies on string ISO comparison via fromisoformat; tolerant to naive 'YYYY-MM-DD' inputs (forces +00:00). Good.
Notifications query uses string 'updated_at' < (now-3d).isoformat() comparison — works because all timestamps are ISO UTC; fine but fragile if TZ formats diverge.
Seed endpoint has no auth (intentional for demo) — fine for preview env, but should be admin-gated in production.
seed_data_creation: Reseeded via POST /api/seed?reseed=true → 3 users, 4 vehicle_types, 30 vehicle_makes, 10 services (incl. 1 bundle), 2 customers, 4 inventory items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter2_backend.py covers seed, makes RBAC, customer min-save, inline vehicles, quotation expiry future/past, convert→job (no signature, status=confirmed), timer start auto-progresses to in_progress, timer stop captures seconds, payment validations (cash partial, knet/credit_card require auth_code, knet with auth_code marks paid), payment delete admin-only, invoice edit recalculates totals, completion auto-generates INV-XXXXX, notifications shape, reports/sales+pnl+jobs+customer-history, PNL admin-only. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter2_backend.py -v. Frontend visually verified Reports page, Customers create flow, Settings makes section, Cmd-K palette.
